## Cloud Kraken (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
N Huge magical beast  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +30  


**Defense**


**AC** 28, touch 15, flat-footed 23 (+5 Dex, +13 natural)  
**hp** 190 (10d10+90)  
**Fort** +14, **Ref** +12, **Will** +7  
**Defensive Abilities** Resist electricity 10, fire 10, cold 15  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 70 ft. (good)  
**Melee** 4 tentacles +23 (3d6+7/19-20)  


**Statistics**

**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (tentacles), Vital Strike, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (tentacle)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)

**Skills** Fly +30, Intimidate +24, Perception +20, Stealth +28  
**SQ** flight

**Environment** any outside
